title: Take a snapshot of long movies
prompt: `Movie` and `Sample` are supplied. Write `public static IEnumerable<string> LongTitles(List<Movie> movies, int limit)`. Return the titles of the movies whose `Minutes` are greater than `limit`, in their original order. The result is a snapshot: it must not change when movies are added to the list afterwards.
hints: When does a Where and Select chain actually run?
A query that has not run yet will see items that are added later.
End the chain with ToList() so the results are stored when the method returns.
checkLabels: With a limit of 40, the sample movies must give Jaws then Alien.
A movie of exactly 60 minutes is not over a limit of 60.
A movie added to the list after the call must not appear in the result.
An empty list must give an empty result.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Returns the query itself, which runs later and sees new items.
Includes a movie whose minutes equal the limit.

feedback: Check the edge at exactly the limit. Then ask when your query runs: at the return, or later when the caller reads it.
